notes:
High-level: Silverbeam is a customer-support SaaS (help center + in-app assistant) that wants a hosted RAG pipeline for KB search. They estimate ~500k-1.2M docs (mostly short articles, threaded replies, attachments). Primary requirement: high QPS (peak 500-1,200 qps for support spikes), sub-200ms tail for users is preferred but they are willing to accept 300-400ms if reranker yields significant precision gains. Cost sensitivity: target end-to-end cost per query (embedding search + reranker) < $0.01, ideally ~$0.002-0.005. They prefer hosted API to avoid managing infra; will consider Dedicated only if cost model or latency cannot be met.

Technical preferences / constraints: using a vector store (FAISS) in front, then a cross-encoder reranker for top-10 reordering. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and quantization for the reranker and recommendations for cheaper cross-encoder alternatives or staged reranking (dense retrieval -> light-weight rerank -> heavy rerank fallthrough). KV/prefix caching for frequent queries is a must. Need model routing/fallback to smaller models during peak or for low-cost tiers.

Security/compliance: SOC2 in place, GRC demands SSO/SAML, audit logs for all API calls, KMS integration, and an EU data residency option (primary customers in EU and NA). Air-gap not required. DPA and IP clauses need legal review.

POC notes (from SE): initial ingest pipeline works; embedding recall good on product docs, but cross-encoder latency ballooning at >800 qps. Marco suggested testing Redwood's batching + automatic KV cache to reduce per-token spend; asked for kernel selection guidance and client-side batching best practices.

Quotes: "We need predictability at scale — spikes during launches kill support SLAs." — Head of Support.

Next actions: 1) Redwood to provide POC cost telemetry export (CSV) and a tuned reranker config with expected cost/QPS curves by 2026-03-17. 2) Legal to review updated DPA template (Priya to loop legal). 3) Schedule exec readout after cost model (wk of 2026-03-24).
